title: PAR-23/7J DIMENSION DSTYLE reader projection
scope: Project the locally modeled DIMENSION tolerance overrides from ACAD/DSTYLE XDATA at the DXF callback boundary
Retain ordered raw XDATA and preserve legacy direct-field values when the override subsection is malformed
Verify ASCII and Binary DXF paths, atomic fallback, unknown values, and following-record alignment

changes.detail: Added complete-subsection validation and atomic projection for DSTYLE variables 47, 48, 71, 72, 146, 272, 274, 279, 283, 284, 285, and 286. Unknown pairs remain raw; malformed or duplicate known values warn and do not alter legacy-parsed fields.
Added dxfRW friendship for the callback-boundary projection and a test-only friend declaration; neither changes object layout or the public callback contract.

Added an existing-target selector with runtime-generated ASCII/Binary controls for valid, unknown, duplicate, and wrongly typed XDATA, exact raw code/value retention, typed values, atomic legacy fallback, and a following LINE sentinel. Temporary files are removed after use.
Updated the 7J ledger and recorded this partial reader-only implementation, its verification, and remaining writer, graph, CLI, and independent-evidence work.

limitations: Only local DXF reading of the modeled DSTYLE subset is implemented.
